plugins.name: Focus timer
plugins.description: A countdown timer in the top bar: click to start one (5, 15, 25 min or your own, with a label), right-click for finished timers. When one ends it notifies, plays an alarm and flashes.
plugins.author: gladimdim

plugins.name: Agents button
plugins.description: One top-bar button that opens a list of the agents turned on in Settings, each with its icon and name; click one to open a new card for it.
plugins.author: gladimdim

plugins.name: Reminder
plugins.description: A bell in the top bar: click it to add a reminder, right-click it to see and remove them. When one is due it notifies, plays a ding-dong and the bell shakes.
plugins.author: gladimdim

plugins.name: SD Editor
plugins.description: A ✎ SD button in the top bar that opens SD Editor, SUPER DESKTOP's built-in text editor card, in the top bar's folder: file tree, tabs, syntax colors, find and replace.
plugins.author: gladimdim

plugins.name: TicTacToe
plugins.description: A tic-tac-toe game that stays on the desktop: a big board with the score beside it, against the computer or a friend. A # in the top bar brings the panel back.
plugins.author: gladimdim
